The '''Warchigade system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Toblain sector/Legends|Toblain sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system shared its name with the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Warchigade trade route]].<ref name="Stock Ships">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Warchigade system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square O-18.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
